description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time (s) for two different models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled "Training Time (s)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 50000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla model is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers. It begins off the top of the chart at a training time of approximately 15000 seconds, showing a steep initial decline that gradually levels out, ending at a loss of exactly 2.50 at a training time of 250000 seconds. The SepLLM model is represented by a solid red line with circular markers. Similar to the Vanilla line, it begins off the top of the chart near 10000 seconds and follows a steep initial decline that gradually flattens, ending at a loss of approximately 2.49 at a training time of roughly 235000 seconds. The plot includes a horizontal dashed green line at a loss of 2.50. The SepLLM line intersects this 2.50 loss level at approximately 198000 seconds, marked by a green star and a vertical dashed green line. The Vanilla line intersects the 2.50 loss level at exactly 250000 seconds, also marked by a green star and a vertical dashed green line. A green double-headed arrow labeled "1.26$\times$" spans the horizontal distance between these two vertical dashed lines.
caption_used: The line plot compares the loss between the vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM model over training time. SepLLM demonstrates a consistently lower loss across all training durations, achieving a final loss of approximately 2.45 at 250,000 seconds, compared to the vanilla model's final loss of 2.50. Additionally, SepLLM exhibits a faster convergence rate, reaching a loss of 2.50 nearly 1.5× faster than the vanilla model, as indicated by the green annotations.
